label: CRT screen — the old TV
description: An old CRT television, full-frame: curved glass (a real barrel bulge), phosphor pixel triad and scanlines, a rolling bright band, bloom, a power-on that springs open from a bright line, timed glitches (a horizontal jolt and flash) and a power-off that collapses to a line and a dot. Shows a big WORD ('2008', 'Over-') in white, green or amber phosphor, or an IMAGE (a cutout, a screenshot). Use it for anything old, legacy, stuck in the past -- the tool 'from 2008', the email platform that is 'about a hundred years old'. Every `at` takes a word anchor.

size.label: Word size (fraction of the screen's height, 0.42)
